{{probeStatusSummary}}\n\nA probe is beh:
{{probeStatusSummary}}

A probe is behind when the monitors it checks, or the network devices it polls, wait more than a minute past their time, so they are checked less often than set. Its page says what lets it catch up. This resolves itself once no probe this monitor watches is behind.
{{probeStatusSummary}}\n\nA probe is dis:
{{probeStatusSummary}}

A probe is disconnected when nothing has been heard from it for three minutes. Monitors that run only on a disconnected probe are not checked until it is back. This resolves itself once every probe this monitor watches is connected again.
